dedupe_keys.name: digitraffic finnish open road rail and marine traffic data apis fintraffic

description: Digitraffic is Fintraffic's service for real-time traffic information on Finnish roads, railways and sea areas, distributed as open data through open APIs. Road data come from the traffic management systems of Fintraffic's road subsidiary and include over 470 road weather cameras, over 350 road weather stations updated every minute, road weather forecasts, traffic measurement system data on average speeds and volumes, traffic messages (now also in DATEX II 3.7) and road maintenance tracking. Railway data cover train timetables and real-time positions through REST and GraphQL interfaces, passenger information messages and daily GTFS packages for passenger trains. Marine data include vessel locations over MQTT WebSockets, winter navigation, sea state estimates and aids-to-navigation faults. Coverage is national (Finland). The data are free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence with attribution guidelines, and developers can register their applications. Digitraffic began in 2002 as a research project of VTT and Helsinki University of Technology before passing to road and transport agencies and then Fintraffic. Caveats: APIs change over time (older DATEX II versions are being deprecated and railway infrastructure content reduced), and history depth varies by API. It supports real-time digital twins, delay and disruption analysis, and weather impact studies across modes. It complements the DATEX II standard and underlies the FI-TW train-weather dataset.
